params.name: difficulty
params.desc: hits among 20 slots: easy 1, medium 3, hard 5, daredevil 10 (the road is 20 − hits lanes)

params.name: lanes
params.desc: lanes crossed (0 = abandoned before the first lane)

note: death-set = shuffle(20)[:deaths]; cross lanes 0..k−1 until a death index is hit; multiplier = floor(rtp·∏(20−i)/(20−deaths−i)); reaching lane 20−deaths (the pier) auto-cashes.
